about_the_game:
Mathbits is a dynamic and challenging math-based game that sharpens your logic, memory, and problem-solving skills through a variety of interactive game modes. Whether you're a casual player or a math enthusiast, Mathbits offers a fun and educational experience with over 50 unique mini-games across five core categories:

  • Guessbit: Guess a hidden number within a given range using feedback hints like "higher" or "lower." Speed and intuition are key!

  • Membit: Test your memory by recalling and typing back numbers, dates, IBANs, phone numbers, and more — with increasing difficulty.

  • Solvebit: Tackle math equations of all kinds — from basic arithmetic to complex algebra. Can you solve them all under pressure?

  • Graphbit: Analyze graphs and equations to find missing parameters. Combine visual thinking with mathematical logic.

  • Seriesbit: Spot patterns and continue number sequences like Fibonacci, primes, and more. It’s all about recognizing trends fast.

  • Calcubit: Solve derivatives as quickly as you can, also challenge yourself with double derivates if brave.

With 10+ unique challenges in each category, Mathbits is designed to train different parts of your brain while keeping you engaged and entertained.

Track your progress with advanced statistics and climb the leaderboards among your friends.
